fix: 向任意一面傳入[#](8B0000)紅石訊號[#]()可完全停止陣列，保留其快取和退避狀態，以便用控制桿或比較器來控制開關。
en:
The array keeps a cache of its six adjacent tanks. The cache refreshes on a timer and also reacts instantly whenever a neighboring block is placed or broken, so tanks can be swapped in or out freely without waiting for the next scan. Neighbors in unloaded chunks are left alone until their chunk ticks in again.\
\
When every cached tank is full the array backs off progressively (like the [#](8B0000)Serenade of the Nether[#]()). While backing off it emits a small puff of drowsy slate-gray particles so you can spot a stalled fountain at a glance; the moment a tank opens up it snaps back to full cadence.\
\
A [#](8B0000)redstone signal[#]() on any face parks the array completely, preserving its cache and backoff state, making it easy to gate with a lever or comparator.
tw:
陣列會快取六個相鄰儲罐的資訊。該快取會週期性重新整理，也會在放置和破壞相鄰方塊時立即重新整理，搬來或搬走儲罐後無需等待掃描。位於未載入區塊的相鄰方塊不計，直至區塊載入為止。\
\
當所有快取儲罐均裝滿時，陣列會漸進式地退避（和[#](8B0000)地獄夜曲[#]()類似）。退避時，陣列會慵懶地產生少量藍灰色粒子，這樣一眼就能看見有陣列停工了；只要有儲罐騰出了空間，陣列就會立即恢復原本的節律。\
\
向任意麵傳入[#](8B0000)紅石訊號[#]()可完全停止陣列，保留其快取和退避狀態，以便用控制桿或比較器限速。

en:
Taming an &3Amphithere&r is similar to how Humans Tamed Wolves into Dogs. It involves a lot of biting... 

First, you'll need to hit a &3Flying Amphithere&r with a Projectile to knock it out of the &bSky&r. 

Then, you can Right Click it to hop on its Back. Like you would with a Horse! But this Horse will swing its head back to Bite you. 

In order to Tame it, you'll need to Survive each Bite and stay on it. In time it will give up and love you. 

Once they love you, you can Ride them! The Controls are a bit wonky but once you play with them a bit (and read this Querst) hopefully you'll understand them better! 

When Riding, you can Press and Hold Space to make the &3Amphithere&r Fly upwards. This will make it Fly directly up from where it is at. When you let go, it will start Dropping back to the Ground. 

When Flying you can use WASD to move in each direction, but you can also use your Mouse Cursor to direct it to Glide upwards or downwards when not using the Space Bar. 

Like &eDeath Worms&r, when Riding you can use (G) to Attack with the &3Amphithere&r.
tw:
馴服一隻&3翼蚺&r類似於人類將狼馴化成狗的方式。這涉及到很多撕咬……

首先，你需要用投擲物擊中一隻&3飛行的翼蚺&r，將其從&b天空&r中擊落。

然後，你可以右鍵點選它跳到它的背上。就像你對馬做的那樣！但這匹馬會回頭咬你。

為了馴服它，你需要在每次撕咬中存活下來並保持在它背上。最終它會捨棄並愛上你。

一旦它們愛上你，你就可以騎乘它們！控制有點古怪，但一旦你稍微練習一下（並閱讀此任務），希望你能更好地理解它們！

騎乘時，你可以按住空白鍵鍵讓&3翼蚺&r上飛。這會讓它直接從目前位置垂直上升。當你鬆開時，它會開始降回地面。

飛行時，你可以使用WASD向各個方向移動，但你也可以使用滑鼠遊標在不使用空白鍵鍵時引導它上或下滑翔。

像&e死亡蠕蟲&r一樣，騎乘時你可以使用(G)鍵讓&3翼蚺&r進行攻擊。

reason: 「不是隻影響」的「隻」應為「只」
fix: 這個生怪磚符文的運作方式和其他的不同。它不是只影響生怪磚的一項數值，而是同時影響多項數值。（其餘照原譯）
en:
This Spawner Rune works differently than the rest. Instead of affecting one stat of the Spawner, it affects multiple at once. It also sets said stats to a specific amount instead of increasing or decreasing each time.

The &aFrontiersman's Spawner Upgrade Rune&r is the first of the Spawner Upgrade Runes, the cheapest, and, of course, weakest.

It sets Minimum Spawn Delay to 150, Maximum Spawn Delay to 600, Spawn Count to 7, Max Entities to 12, and Activation Range to 24.
{@pagebreak}
To determine when the Spawner will spawn it picks a random number between the Maximum and Minimum Spawn Delay. The speed is expressed in ticks where 20 ticks equals 1 second.

The Mobs spawned is random with a Maximum amount determined by the Spawn Count.

Max entities is the amount of mobs that can be spawned by a spawner and kept. If it's only 6 max entities when 6 mobs are already spawned no more will spawned until they're dead or moved.

Activation Range is how close the Player (You) must be to the Spawner for it to work.
tw:
這個生怪磚符文的運作方式和其他的不同。它不是隻影響生怪磚的一項數值，而是同時影響多項數值。而且它會把這些數值設定為特定數字，而不是每次增加或減少。

&a邊疆人的生怪磚升級符文&r是生怪磚升級符文中的第一個，也是最便宜、當然也是最弱的。

它會把最短生成延遲設為 150、最長生成延遲設為 600、生成數量設為 7、最大實體數設為 12，並把啟動範圍設為 24。
{@pagebreak}
生怪磚何時生成，是從最長和最短生成延遲之間隨機選一個數字決定的。速度以 tick 為單位，20 tick 等於 1 秒。

生成的怪物是隨機的，數量上限由生成數量決定。

最大實體數是生怪磚可以生成並保留的怪物數量。如果最大實體數只有 6，那麼當 6 隻怪物已經生成後，在它們死亡或被移動之前，就不會再生成更多。

啟動範圍是玩家（也就是你）必須離生怪磚多近，它才會運作。
